issue.title: 0b30610471 left 4 stale tests: bead_hooks env=None mock expectations and unclassified bead read --project/--reason
issue.description:
Found by the sase-15b land agent (unrelated to that epic). Observed in `just check` tool run 9049a4c1ebbee47e5f92de15762b63d4 at sase master 651a32ee00, where the scoped lane escalated to the full suite. The same nodes fail in 8-12 of the last 40 recorded check runs across workspaces.

Root cause: commit 0b30610471 ("feat(beads): add audited sase bead read with visible read reasons", agent 0on) changed two things without updating the tests that pin them:

1. `src/sase/workflows/commit/bead_hooks.py::_run_bead_command` gained a keyword-only `env` parameter and now always passes `env=env` (None by default) to `subprocess.run`. The three `tests/test_commit_bead_hooks.py::TestHandleBeads` tests below still `assert_called_once_with(...)` without `env`, so they fail with "Expected: run([...sync], cwd=..., capture_output=True, check=False) / Actual: ... env=None":
   - test_assigned_bead_syncs_without_reading_or_closing
   - test_bead_sync_runs_when_bead_dir_exists
   - test_bead_sync_runs_when_split_sidecar_exists
2. The new `sase bead read` free-text options `--project` and `--reason` were never classified in `tests/test_bead/test_cli_at_path_values.py` (`_EXPANDED_FREE_TEXT` or `_DELIBERATELY_LITERAL_FREE_TEXT`). `test_every_bead_free_text_option_is_classified` now reports `[('read', 'project'), ('read', 'reason'), ('touched', 'verb')]`. The `('touched', 'verb')` entry is already tracked as a DISCOVERED ISSUE on epic sase-14j; this task covers only the two `read` options.

Fix: update the three mock expectations to include `env=None` (or assert on the kwargs that matter), and classify `read --project` / `read --reason` (decide whether `@path` expansion is wanted for the audit reason). Verify with `just check`.

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: Deterministic: the mock-call assertion mismatches on the env=None kwarg that 0b30610471 made _run_bead_command always pass, and the free-text classification set is static; both fail identically on every full-suite run (8-12 of the last 40 recorded check runs across workspaces, every run that selected them).

payload.description: sase-14j's DISCOVERED ISSUE covers the ('touched','verb') entry of the same free-text classification test
